title: Unlink does not stop the sync: the next change links the pair again by email
subtitle: TAVI CRM / Desk (staging, tenant NDC-Staging) vs Zoho help docs / NDC-1669

text: Zoho has no per-record Unlink button; a mapping is removed only by the delete preferences ("only the mapping is removed").
Expected here: TAVI's own promise — syncing stops for the unlinked record until it is linked again.
